set.approach: Park near the end of the road at the Roaring Fork trailhead on the Lake Granby side. The trail is steep at first, crosses a high pass and drops to lush meadows beneath Stone Lake. Below the conspicuous three-tier tower, a talus gully shaped like a cone is where the climb starts. Ladybug Direct begins near the base of the southeast buttress and is a more direct start to that buttress route.
set.descent_text: Follow the west ridge down to the low point between Hiamovi Tower and Hiamovi Mountain, and from there step down through grass-covered ledges and ramps, finishing in the meadow below the route.

review.notes: Area page (Hiamovi) approach and descent; route page: starts at the base of the buttress.
